scope: Supplement to earlier14-paper code audit. Primary papers/author pages + reachable author-linked GitHub trees and selected text files only; not a systematic exhaustive survey or full-source read. No dependencies/assets/model downloads, inference, evaluation, paid API calls, external mutations or project code edits.
target_task: Observed empty room shell + exact required textual furniture inventory without per-object sizes -> layout/dimensions -> RoomGenBench realization.
naming_correction: SceneCraft-LLM (Hu, ICML2024), SceneCraft-layout (Yang, NeurIPS2024), and Open-Universe-2024 (Aguina-Kang et al.) are THREE distinct papers. Open-Universe is not a SceneCraft subtitle.

entries.name: AnyHome
entries.title: AnyHome: Open-Vocabulary Generation of Structured and Textured 3D Homes

venue.name: ECCV 2024
venue.date_note: 2024 conference, 2023 preprint; do not label first introduced in 2024.

entries.primary_official_proof: Author Brown IVL project explicitly links FreddieRao/anyhome_github.

input.observed_shell: Default generates house floor plan, not fixed observed shell.
input.sizes: Structured representation predicts geometry; retrieves CAD assets.

entries.method: LLM templates -> hierarchical house/room/object representation -> constrained layout + CAD retrieval -> SDS layout refinement -> egocentric texture inpainting.
paper_evaluation: OOB (paper mixes boundary/intersection wording; freeze exact definition before borrowing).
Caption similarity, CLIP text-content and style similarity; rendered-view perturbations.
entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Need bypass floor-plan/inventory expansion, enforce exact required IDs, preserve observed polygon/openings, separate bbox vs realized mesh.
innovation_claims_excluded: Open-vocabulary text-to-house and hierarchical intermediate representation.
Combining structured layout, asset retrieval and texturing; multistage generation itself.
limits: Current public tree has only18 blobs; README explicitly promises gradual module release.
main.py calls floorplan and layout generators; no standalone paper scorer or SDS/texture implementation identified in scanned tree.
Repository availability does not mean complete paper pipeline reproduced.

entries.name: SceneTeller
entries.title: SceneTeller: Language-to-3D Scene Generation

input.observed_shell: Room dimensions in layout-generation prompt; README defaults regular floor plan.
input.inventory: Text describes placements/orientations; not exact canonical request IDs.

entries.method: Language ICL/CoT layout generation -> CAD assembly -> Gaussian splatting -> instruction-guided global/object stylization.
paper_evaluation: Category-count precision/recall and exact-scene accuracy; bbox mIoU and OOB.
Style-only CLIP; FID against ScanNet rendered images.
Human realism/text alignment/geometric fidelity/compositional plausibility.

code_evaluation_evidence.observed: Vendored FID evaluator, not proof of all paper scoring.

entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Need observed shell/opening and exact-ID adapter; single-GT mIoU is auxiliary because many layouts satisfy plain inventory. Style score does not measure functional layout.
limits: Full tree1047 blobs includes vendored rendering/GS frameworks; selected source/README checked, not all source read.
Tree contains ATISS FID/KL and CLIP helper; standalone paper layout precision/recall/mIoU/OOB scoring entry not identified in LayoutGen tree.
No complete human-study reproduction established.

entries.name: DeBaRA
entries.title: DeBaRA: Denoising-Based 3D Room Arrangement Generation
entries.primary_official_proof: NeurIPS proceedings + author Maks Ovsjanikov publication page confirm paper; no official Code link identified. Author page https://www.lix.polytechnique.fr/~maks/publications.html search result lists paper only; direct fetch timed out.

code.status: Official repository not verified; do not infer no code exists anywhere.

input.text: Uses object semantic categories and optional external LLM to propose category sets.
input.observed_shell: Floor plan conditioning, including complex room boundaries.
input.inventory: Given object category set for layout generation.
input.sizes: Predicts spatial attributes including sizes; re-arrangement can fix dimensions.

entries.method: Lightweight spatially-aware conditional score model; floor encoder and object attributes; iterative denoising; Self Score Evaluation selects LLM semantic sets.
paper_evaluation: Top-down FID/KID/SCA.
Accumulated outside-boundary object area OBA in m².
Completion/re-arrangement and efficiency analyses.
entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Close task match at category-list + floor-plan level. Needs text-description/open-vocabulary/door/support adapter and official implementation access; fixed-category unknown-size layout is established prior work.
innovation_claims_excluded: Fixed object categories while jointly predicting size/position/orientation.
Using learned scene score to choose external LLM proposals.
limits: No official repo verified after paper, author-page and targeted GitHub search; code availability remains unconfirmed.
Do not convert paper equations into a claim released scorer exists.

entries.name: EchoScene
entries.title: EchoScene: Indoor Scene Generation via Information Echo over Scene Graph Diffusion

input.text: Native input semantic scene graph, not free-form inventory only.
input.observed_shell: Room node/scene graph conditions; fixed detailed observed shell not established here.
input.inventory: Graph nodes specify objects; edges supply relationships.
input.sizes: Generates layout and object shapes; EchoLayout variant uses retrieval.

entries.method: Dual layout/shape diffusion branches; graph convolution aggregates and echoes per-node denoising information each step; graph editing.
paper_evaluation: Scene FID/CLIP-FID/KID.
Graph-constraint accuracy/mean scene graph constraint score.
Shape MMD/COV/1-NNA, Chamfer inter-object consistency.

code_evaluation_evidence.observed: Public geometry/graph metric module; full behavior not audited here.

entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Requires external text->graph compiler with no GT relations and canonical IDs; preserve actual shell/openings. SG is stronger relation input than an unstructured mandatory inventory.
innovation_claims_excluded: Joint layout and shape generation conditioned on a scene graph.
limits: README has eval_3dfront and FID commands, assets/models links.
Some README-mentioned object-fidelity/consistency filenames were not located in scanned current tree; not all reported evaluators proven released.
Textures are a separate downstream method; code README says paper prevails on discrepancies.

entries.name: HSM
entries.title: HSM: Hierarchical Scene Motifs for Multi-Scale Indoor Scene Generation

venue.name: 3DV 2026
venue.date_note: 2025 first preprint; current author project and arXiv explicitly identify 3DV2026.

input.inventory: Text decomposed into objects at each hierarchy level.
input.assets: HSSD retrieval and geometric support-region extraction; actual asset geometry available.

entries.method: Hierarchical support regions + learned reusable scene-motif programs + spatial optimization; same motif machinery arranges furniture and small objects across scales.
paper_evaluation: SceneEval count/attribute/object-object/object-architecture fidelity; collision/support/NAV/ACC/OOB plausibility.
BLIP-2/Long-CLIP/VQA alignment; human scene/small-object preferences.
Support-region IoU/F1 at region matching threshold.

code_evaluation_evidence.observed: SceneEval export and warning against GLB evaluation.

entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Close open-vocabulary, boundary-aware functional comparison; must bypass item invention and preserve requested IDs; separate retrieval-known geometry from unknown-size layout-first track.
innovation_claims_excluded: Reusable relational arrangement/motif programs across scales.
limits: README exports stk_scene_state.json and delegates evaluation to SceneEval.
README explicitly warns not to evaluate debug GLB because room origin misaligned.
Needs licensed HSSD and API endpoint; no data/weights generation run.

entries.name: SceneCraft-LLM
entries.title: SceneCraft: An LLM Agent for Synthesizing 3D Scenes as Blender Code

venue.name: ICML 2024
venue.note: First author page additionally labels Oral.

entries.primary_official_proof: PMLR proceedings identify exact title/authors/venue; first-author page lists PDF and ICML Oral, but no Code link for this entry.

code.status: Official repository not verified; do not infer no code exists anywhere.

input.observed_shell: General 3D scenes, not specifically fixed indoor shell.
input.inventory: Synthetic constrained text queries; Sintel experiment supplies fixed assets.
input.sizes: Constraint script/solver chooses size, pose and composition; asset conditions vary by experiment.

entries.method: LLM scene graph -> executable Blender Python constraints -> solver/render -> GPT-V critique and script refinement; outer loop learns reusable spatial-skill library.
paper_evaluation: CLIP and human-authored constraint score on synthetic queries.
Human text fidelity/composition/aesthetics.
Sintel layout-matrix similarity/CLIP and downstream FVD/relative matching.
entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: General program-synthesis prior art, not a drop-in mandatory-furniture room baseline. Need fixed shell/inventory, unified asset conditions and scripts that export actual instance poses.
innovation_claims_excluded: Reusable skill/program library and improvement without parameter tuning.
limits: No official repo verified from PMLR, arXiv, author page or targeted search; do not substitute unrelated OrangeSodahub repo.
Paper includes prompts/algorithm but this is not proof of released executable evaluator.

entries.name: SceneCraft-layout
entries.title: SceneCraft: Layout-Guided 3D Scene Generation
entries.primary_official_proof: Author project and arXiv Code links OrangeSodahub/SceneCraft.

input.observed_shell: Full provided bounding-box scene and camera trajectory.
input.inventory: Object categories and shapes/layout already encoded in union-of-boxes BBS.
input.sizes: Already provided by layout; does not solve unknown layout.

entries.method: Render semantic/depth proxy maps from BBS -> layout-conditioned diffusion images -> NeRF scene via distillation, supporting complex multi-room trajectories.
paper_evaluation: CLIP Score and Inception Score.
32-person 1–5 human 3D-consistency/visual-quality ratings.
Paper explicitly does not use FID for its primary cross-method comparison.

code_evaluation_evidence.observed: Metric dispatch CS/IS/FID/KID; selected source read only, unexecuted.

entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Downstream appearance/geometry realization module after layout, not competing unknown-size layout predictor. Input privileges must not be hidden.
innovation_claims_excluded: Semantic/depth proxy rendering and multi-view scene distillation.
limits: Public metrics source contains CS/IS plus FID/KID implementations; code presence does not mean FID/KID were headline paper metrics.
No human-study raw-data reproduction established; model/data/renderer dependencies substantial.

entries.name: Open-Universe-2024
entries.title: Open-Universe Indoor Scene Generation using LLM Program Synthesis and Uncurated Object Databases
entries.primary_official_proof: First-author publications page lists exact paper as Arxiv preprint2024 with PDF only. This paper is distinct from both SceneCraft papers.

code.status: Official repository not verified; do not infer no code exists anywhere.

input.observed_shell: Optional room size/fullness; fixed arbitrary observed polygon not established.
input.inventory: Program synthesizer expands description into open-vocabulary object list.
input.assets: Uncurated Objaverse retrieval; bbox size preferences and VLM orientation.

entries.method: LLM scene-description DSL -> gradient layout optimization/error correction -> category/single-object/size-aware retrieval -> multistep asset orientation.
paper_evaluation: Two-alternative forced-choice preference for closed/open-universe scenes.
Component studies for program synthesis/retrieval/orientation; timing.
entries.fixed_inventory_unknown_size_gap: Relevant program/retrieval prior art; needs exact furniture IDs, observed shell/openings, and size/asset verification. Do not name this SceneCraft.
innovation_claims_excluded: Joint semantic/size-aware uncurated retrieval and geometry-based layout optimization.
limits: Original official repo not verified. Related coauthor repository mxgmn/ImperativeScene links DeclarativeScene, but target https://github.com/mxgmn/DeclarativeScene returns404 in this check.
ImperativeScene is follow-up code, not evidence original2024 evaluation release.
First-arXiv date follows actual arXiv metadata Feb5 despite2403 identifier.

takeaways: DeBaRA directly rules out claiming fixed-category unknown-size room arrangement or lightweight conditional layout generation as wholly new. Official code still unverified.
HSM rules out broad novelty claims around hierarchical large/small furniture, support regions, motif/program reuse and recursive dense arrangements.
SceneTeller/AnyHome/SceneCraft-LLM/Open-Universe establish staged language planning, structured programs, layout refinement, retrieval and stylization; an additional stage alone is not innovation.
SceneCraft-layout belongs in downstream layout-to-realized-scene family, not the same layout-prediction main table.

A defensible FastFill contribution needs concrete advantage under equal fixed-inventory inputs: e.g. lower compute with independent constraint/mesh success, explicit uncertainty/repair/calibration, or a new verifiable interface; this is a research hypothesis, not established novelty.
